Uptime Kuma worked great… until my homelab got big enough that “just add another monitor” became a maintenance strategy. 😅  

I switched to Gatus for YAML-based monitoring, easier bulk changes, and smarter alerting with n8n + Valkey + ntfy.  

Full write-up:
https://s.adhdhomelab.com/10MnD
